title: Decision trace
description: Decision trace (docs/04-predicates-and-facts.md section 5; FR-10, FR-11, FR-16, NFR-01). The trace is the single source for the audit log, the applicant notice, the reviewer view and the explanation tests. Rules: (1) steps list every ACTIVE rule in layer order, each exactly once, with a status; (2) money and ratios are strings holding exact decimals, whole-rupee amounts are integers, and no JSON number with a fractional part is allowed anywhere; (3) every code in reason_codes has a fired step with the same reason_code, and no other fired step supplies a code (DT-2: reason_codes holds the codes of the winning outcome's fired rules, in step order); (4) decision_id and evaluated_at are added by the API layer after the decision is computed and are the only fields replay ignores (docs/audit-log-spec.md section 5). Schema checks structure only; the checks in (1) and (3) are tests, not schema keywords.

decision_id.description: Unique ID for this decision, assigned by the API layer. Format d-0001, d-0002 and so on (a counter in the audit store, never random, never derived from the input).

applicant_ref.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of applicant_id, prefixed sha256:. Stable per applicant; the join key to the audit-only attribute store (DR-02). Decision P3-2.

input_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the validated input (docs/audit-log-spec.md section 3), prefixed sha256:.

rule_set_version.description: Tag of all rule and parameter files, for example rules-1.0.0+params-0.1.0. Includes the experimental switches.

rule_set_hash.description: SHA-256 over the normalised rule and parameter files (docs/09-file-formats.md section 7). Must equal the value in tests/golden/rule_set_pin.json for the baseline rule set.

evaluated_at.description: UTC timestamp, whole seconds, set by the API layer after the decision is computed.

steps.description: Every active rule in layer order. order starts at 1 and increases by 1.

derived.description: Every computed value that is not a rule outcome: existing FOIR, EMI, post-loan FOIR, APR and similar. Exact decimals as strings.

reason_codes.description: Reason codes of the winning outcome's fired rules, in step order (DT-2). Empty for an eligible decision with no reduced-offer rule. For the default REFER (CP-8.1) it is ["NO_RULE_APPLICABLE"].

value.description: A fact or derived value: whole-rupee integers and counts are integers; money with paise, ratios, rates and enumerations are strings; flags are booleans; null means unknown. No fractional JSON numbers.

rule_version.description: The version field of the rule's metadata (FR-10).

outcome.description: Present only when status is fired.

reason_code.description: Present only when status is fired and the rule has a reason code.

facts_used.description: Names and values of the facts and parameters the rule read. For not_fired and fired steps. Never contains a protected attribute.

missing.description: Present only when status is not_evaluated: the unknown fields (DT-5: every unknown field the rule reads).

skipped_reason.description: Present only when status is skipped: why, for example blocked by an earlier INELIGIBLE or REFER outcome.

derived.description: Values this rule derived (band, caps, recommended amount, rate).
